items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: 2nd record date w/ C & F. George Steinbeck replaced Chuck Barksdale on bass... Think Chuck got sick, I believe. Went back to Chicago.

ctx.x: When we started off -- No, I think we went to Chicago or somewhere. They had to break me in good first, you know. But the first job I think we went to Chicago, 'cause he had a couple of cars [?]. We returned to the Apollo Theater -- it was packed, cause it was between the Ink Spots and ourselves, running neck and neck. The Ink Spots were ahead, not neck and neck. They were ahead, but we were right on their heels. They took off, boy.
2nd record date w/ C & F. George Steinbeck replaced Chuck Barksdale on bass, ...
Oh yeah, George, yeah. Very good bass player. Think Chuck got sick, I believe. Went back to Chicago. Anyhow George, he was a good solid bass player -- he was with Basil for a while I think.
